To connect programmatically to an AWS service, you use an endpoint. Service quotas, also referred
to as limits, are the maximum number of service resources or operations for your AWS account.
Amazon OpenSearch UI is the next generation OpenSearch user interface for OpenSearch
Dashboards. It provides endpoints for accessing your OpenSearch dashboards. Use this topic to ﬁnd
the service endpoints and service quotas for OpenSearch UI.
For more information on other OpenSearch services, see  Service Endpoints and Quotas.

hierarchy.parent: Using OpenSearch UI in Amazon OpenSearch Service
